title: Status answers without the flow numbers; master status reads them from /api/flow
description: A fresh control plane's authenticated /api/status answers within the installer's 30 s check, runs no flow query and carries no flow; GET /api/flow returns the 6 hour, 24 hour and 7 day numbers, and master status shows 75% first pass and the review attention line read from /api/flow.

steps.name: a fresh install's /api/status answers within 30 s without reading flow; /api/flow returns it
master status still shows the flow numbers from /api/flow
